title: How, more than who
sub: Film 4 of People first, in Leading data people: how a team works together counts for more than who is in it. Give everyone a turn, disagree about the work and never the person, keep small promises, and write one page on how you work together, in the team's own words.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's sunlit plaster: a gorge in the Andes, then the team's room in daylight, with sheets pinned to the wall. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans (the team's page), orange is data (the two numbers), green is something done or agreed, and amber a risk (a disagreement that turns to the person).
